description: Check whether marketing claims and calls to action are specific enough to believe. It catches the vague superlative, like "the best" or "#1", that readers discount on sight. It catches promises with no proof behind them and results with no mechanism, and it flags the generic buttons everyone uses, like "Learn more" and "Get started". Then it tells you how to fix each one. Use it when you write or review claims like "results in days", "trusted by thousands" or "the #1 tool", and for any button text. For headlines, check_headlines does the full job.

context.description: For a claim in the body, the paragraph around it, so a mechanism named nearby still counts.

text.description: The claim or the button text, exactly as written.

type.description: Use headline, cta for a button or call to action, or body_claim for a claim inside the copy.

name: check_marketing_claims
title: Check marketing claims and CTAs
